# getID3 1.9.27

Unmodified read-only modules from https://github.com/JamesHeinrich/getID3/tree/v1.9.27.
Used under MPL 2.0; see `license.mpl-20.txt` and upstream `license.txt`.
Archive SHA-256: `6fe9aabe794e70336230993799e6294e0cf3443f4303c1bc2176c1a16d060e99`.

Includes the core, MPEG/RIFF readers and their dependencies, plus ID3v1, ID3v2,
APE and Lyrics3 tag readers. No tag writers, demos or external helper programs.
Deploy this entire directory with `php/inc/vz2_audio_metadata.php` and
`php/inc/vz2_media.php`; Composer and shell execution are not needed on hosting.
